title: Detecting and Correcting Hate Speech in Multimodal Memes with Large Visual Language Model

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the Large Visual Language Model's (VLM) ability to detect and correct hateful multimodal memes targeting racial groups using zero-shot prompting and human expert evaluation.
Testing the model's reasoning and detection capabilities on hateful memes targeting specific religious groups (e.g., Shia Muslims) and evaluating its zero-shot text correction.
Assessing the model's capacity to identify derogatory terms and hate speech directed at transgender individuals within the combined visual and textual context of memes.

Evaluating whether the model can accurately analyze visual elements (e.g., a wheelchair) and text to distinguish between supportive sentiment and hate speech directed at individuals with disabilities.
Evaluating the model's ability to identify hateful stereotypes about immigrants and rewrite the meme's text into positive, respectful content promoting diversity.
